originalIdScope.requirement: A complete minimal positive Rust Run exercising the Rust universe/fact/Coverage path.
originalIdScope.observable: exported Rust Run frames plus replay

originalIdScope.requirement: The Rust reconstruction includes a mixed-edition workspace.
originalIdScope.observable: edition map with more than one edition on a claimed Rust complete Run

originalIdScope.requirement: A target-specific edition differs from its package default.
originalIdScope.observable: measured target edition ≠ package default on a claimed Rust complete Run

originalIdScope.requirement: Body-specific dialect selection from admitted compiler context and body provenance.
originalIdScope.observable: clone/body records carrying derived dialect, not a workspace-wide guess

originalIdScope.requirement: The same physical file under distinct explicitly selected target editions.

originalIdScope.requirement: A valid # marker directory is exhibited on the Rust reconstruction.
originalIdScope.observable: inventoried path containing the published # marker form

originalIdScope.requirement: Body identity is stable when only ownership selection changes without changing effective dialect. This is a measured pair, not a sentence.
originalIdScope.observable: two retained graphs or an explicit pair vector comparing body identities

originalIdScope.requirement: A representative large edition map, with the bounded version component derived from admitted compiler context and body provenance.
originalIdScope.observable: retained edition map plus derived version component; may be on a claimed Rust Run or a pair vector that still uses admitted context/body provenance

originalIdScope.requirement: Bounded version component is derived, not guessed.
originalIdScope.observable: measured derivation inputs (admitted context, body provenance) retained

originalIdScope.requirement: A complete Run (or claimed-positive graph) exhibiting partial enumeration with an empty clone view that does not claim complete Coverage from partial ownership.
originalIdScope.observable: exported graph whose clones Coverage is the published partial/unknown pairing, not complete-empty from partial ownership

originalIdScope.requirement: Partial/ambiguous clone ownership uses the precise published deficiency/nativeCause pairing and output projection.
originalIdScope.observable: Coverage entry pairing measured against the cited kit selectors

originalIdScope.requirement: A complete syntax-only Run for a bundled data/document grammar: inventory capability present; unsupported capabilities explicit refusal or unavailability. A complete empty result must not conceal unsupported analysis.
originalIdScope.observable: exported syntax data Run; clones/unsupported capabilities not complete-empty when unsupported

originalIdScope.requirement: Semantic capabilities that the universe cannot serve are correctly unavailable, not silent complete-empty.
originalIdScope.observable: published deficiency/nativeCause (or equivalent kit pairing) on the unsupported request

originalIdScope.requirement: TS and Rust complete positives have nonempty selected native contexts.
originalIdScope.observable: plan.nativeContextDigests nonempty and retained on those Runs

originalIdScope.requirement: At least one claimed complete positive uses actual imported payload records together with registered relation and native Coverage. A schema-valid import wrapper that is not a graph member does not satisfy this.

originalIdScope.scopeThisRecheck: satisfied if ts graph admits with import member

originalIdScope.requirement: Native dependency and configuration H preimages are reconstructed from the normative recipes and retained on the language Runs that name them.
originalIdScope.observable: retained nested preimages joining the universe/context fields that name them

originalIdScope.requirement: At least one complete Run carries file facts whose inventoried path/hash/length checks are independently reconstructed.
originalIdScope.observable: exported Run whose file facts join snapshot inventory path, digest, and length under the registered file law
originalIdScope.scopeThisRecheck: may be ts or rust if file facts actually present; syntax-code outside
originalIdScope.pendingGlobal: syntax-code frozen/outside this four-Run recheck; not a per-Run demand on ts and rust

originalIdScope.requirement: Clone body identities at L0 and a normalized level on that complete file-fact reconstruction.
originalIdScope.observable: L0 and normalized clone facts with retained frames
originalIdScope.scopeThisRecheck: NOT a per-language/per-Run demand on every TS and Rust graph
originalIdScope.pendingGlobal: unreviewed syntax-code member of the at-least-one set is pending global integration; absence on ts/rust is not a failure of each scoped graph

originalIdScope.requirement: Level-specification, source, and language-version custody for those clone identities.
originalIdScope.observable: retained level-specification bytes and language-version derivation inputs
originalIdScope.scopeThisRecheck: same at-least-one set; not a per-Run demand
originalIdScope.pendingGlobal: pending global integration with the parent at-least-one set

originalIdScope.requirement: A complete compiler-free syntax-only Run for a supported code grammar with inventory and syntax/clone facts.
originalIdScope.observable: exported syntax code Run frames plus replay

originalIdScope.requirement: A repository with no TypeScript or Rust compilation unit, with exact context/universe/provider/grammar custody.
originalIdScope.observable: syntax Run(s) without TS/Rust compilation units; retained context/universe/provider/grammar

originalIdScope.requirement: At least one refused hidden/mismatched input for TypeScript and at least one for Rust. Record first refusal and masking.
